Built for Franchise HQs & Multi-Store Operators

Xilnex is a Southeast Asian cloud-based point-of-sale platform for retail and F&B businesses running multiple outlets, headquartered in Malaysia and serving businesses across the region. It unifies sales, inventory, loyalty, kitchen operations and reporting in one system, keeps working offline, and is trusted by 5,000+ businesses with 30,000+ installations across Malaysia, Indonesia, Thailand, Cambodia, Vietnam and Singapore.

Why Multi-Outlet Brands Choose Xilnex

Most growing operators end up running three systems that don’t talk to each other. Xilnex keeps checkout, customers, reporting and staff in one.

Sell with confidence

Every terminal keeps taking payments through an outage and syncs the queue back to head office the moment the line returns.

Offline capable · Syncs on reconnect

Build customer relationships

One membership works across every branch, with points applied at the till rather than on a card someone forgot to bring.

One card · Every branch

Make decisions from data

Compare outlet against outlet without exporting anything first. Variance and shrinkage surface daily, not at the stocktake.

Daily · Not monthly

Operate consistently at scale

Set a price or a promotion once at head office and push it to every branch in a single action, then see which terminals applied it.

One action · Every outlet

Built for Your Industry

The offline claim is the one most operators have been burned on before. This is exactly what happens, in order.

  1. 01

    At the till

    A sale is rung up on the terminal. Stock moves, the member is recognised, the receipt prints. Under two seconds, whether the line is up or down.

  2. 02

    If the line drops

    The terminal keeps trading. Transactions queue locally instead of failing, so the counter never stops because the internet did.

  3. 03

    On reconnect

    The queue syncs in order. No re-keying, no reconciling two sets of numbers at close, no gap in the day’s figures.

  4. 04

    At head office

    Every outlet lands in one back office. Pricing, promotions and product data are set once here and pushed back down.

  5. 05

    In Insights

    Outlet against outlet, daily. Variance and shrinkage surface while you can still do something about them.

Steps 02 and 03 are the difference between a bad afternoon and a lost one. Ask us how it behaves on your connection →

Frequently Asked Questions

The questions operators ask before the first call, answered in plain language.

Ask us something else →
What is Xilnex?
A Southeast Asian cloud POS platform for multi-outlet retail and F&B businesses, headquartered in Malaysia, combining sales, inventory, loyalty and reporting in one system. 5,000+ businesses, 30,000+ installations.
Is it only for chains, or single outlets too?
Works for a single outlet through to nationwide franchises, but the centralised multi-branch controls are built specifically for operators with more than one location.
Does it work without internet?
Yes, POS keeps taking sales offline and syncs automatically once reconnected.
Is Xilnex ISO certified?
Yes, ISO 27001:2022, certified by IRQS under NABCB, recognised by IAF.
Explore 3 more questions +3 ↗
How much does it cost?
Depends on outlet count, modules and hardware, scoped per business, contact us for a tailored quote.
How is Xilnex different from a POS built for single-outlet shops?
Franchise HQ controls, centralised pricing, promotions and reporting across every outlet, are core to Xilnex, not a feature bolted onto a single-store tool. Xilnex has also been operating since 2007, longer than most regional POS providers.
Does Xilnex support e-Invoice compliance?
Yes, Xilnex supports e-Invoice compliance in line with LHDN requirements.

POS for retail chains & franchises in Malaysia

Xilnex is a cloud point-of-sale system for retail chains and franchise networks in Malaysia. Head office sets pricing, promotions and product data once and pushes them to every outlet, while each branch or franchisee keeps its own reporting. Over 30,000 installations across 5,000+ businesses since 2007.
